description:
Perform a safety screen for a patient on Methotrexate who requires antibiotic therapy. Open the Liverpool Cancer iChart app and check the interaction severity for these three specific antibiotics against Methotrexate:

1. Amoxicillin
2. Co-trimoxazole (Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole)
3. Ciprofloxacin

Create a report file at '/sdcard/mtx_antibiotic_screen.txt' with the following format (replace [COLOR] with the actual traffic light color displayed: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, or Grey):

Amoxicillin: [COLOR]
Co-trimoxazole: [COLOR]
Ciprofloxacin: [COLOR]
